details: Russian President Vladimir Putin has agreed "in principle" to resume trilateral negotiations with the United States and Ukraine on ending the war after November 10. This development follows a meeting between Putin and US President Donald Trump's envoy Steve Witkoff. The talks aim to build a security system for Russia and Ukraine post-conflict.
title: Putin Agrees to Resume Ukraine Peace Talks with US and Kyiv

details: Bitcoin has surged past $83,000, extending its recovery from recent lows. This positive momentum is driven by stronger-than-expected corporate earnings reports from U.S. tech giants like SpaceX and Super Micro Computer, which have revived optimism in AI investments and lifted broader market sentiment. Additionally, U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs have recorded a second consecutive day of net inflows, indicating increasing institutional interest.
title: Bitcoin Rebounds Above $83,000 Amid Strong U.S. Earnings & ETF Inflows
